availability.note: Jaecoo build-your-own lists J5 EV with one grade, Summit, 'From $36,990^ driveaway'; model page https://www.omodajaecoo.com.au/models/jaecoo-j5-bev agrees (Summit only). CarsGuide 2027 price page lists one EV grade (Summit Ev).

listPrice.note: Jaecoo AU offers page, J5 EV novated lease footnote: 'The 10% National Fleet Discount is applied to the manufacturer's recommended retail price of $35,990 and excludes Registration, CTP, Stamp Duty, and Dealer Delivery costs' (manufacturer's own price, before on-roads in words). Agrees with CarsGuide 2027 MSRP $35,990, CarExpert review $35,990 before on-road costs, Chasing Cars 'list price of $35,990 before on-road costs'. Jaecoo's $36,990 national drive-away is a campaign (orders 1/11/2026-30/11/2026, no metallic paint). Back-out alternative (36990-880)/1.042 = 34,654 round-trips to $36,989.47 via calc/onroad.js, but the manufacturer's stated RRP overrides it; RRP 35,990 gives Vic drive-away $38,381.58, $1,392 above the campaign DAP. The jaecoo-j7-shs pattern MSRP = DAP - $2,000 does not hold here (DAP - $1,000).

batteryKwh.note: EV Database UK: Useable Capacity 58.9 kWh, Nominal 60.9 kWh (Jaecoo UK quotes 60.9). AU spec sheet 'Battery Capacity (kWh) 58.9' LFP, unlabelled; same pack as chery-e5

rangeKm.note: Jaecoo UK E5 (same 58.9/60.9 kWh pack, 18in 235/55 R18 as AU): WLTP 248 miles = 399 km, same for Pure and Luxury. EV Database EU lists WLTP 402 km TEL / 399 km TEH (https://ev-database.org/car/3336/Jaecoo-5-EV); the AU spec sheet's 'Pure Electric Range (WLTP km) 402' is the TEL best case, so the TEH figure is taken for the fully-loaded Summit. Not an NEDC figure (AU sheet labels WLTP); difference 0.75%. Held value 402.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 58.9/399 x 100 = 14.76. Jaecoo claim 14.3 (quoted by CarExpert) not reconcilable with the pack and range; EU rated 165-166 Wh/km includes charging losses. Held value 14.3.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: AU spec sheet 'Luggage Capacity - VDA (L) Up to Cargo Cover 384' (480 to roof); frunk 35 L not added

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: EV Database 'Cargo Volume Max 1180 L'; Jaecoo UK '480/1180' litres. Pairs with the 480 L to-roof figure, so measured to the roof; no belt-line folded figure published, AU spec sheet gives none. Reads high against the convention (as chery-e5).

towKg.note: AU spec sheet 'Maximum Towing Mass - Braked 1,250', unbraked 750, towball 75

warrantyYears.note: 8 years/unlimited km from first registration incl. BEVs; condition is servicing per manufacturer guidelines, not dealer-only; no shorter private fallback (150,000 km cap only for taxi/rideshare/rental); HV battery same terms

insuranceAnnual.note: matched to chery-e5-ultimate (same pack, same $35,990 list, 1500) and byd-atto3-essential ($39,990, 1500); held value kept

depreciationCurve.note: Omoda/Jaecoo/Chery brand convention (jaecoo-j7-shs, jaecoo-j8-shs, omoda-9-shs, chery-e5 all use it; one curve per brand). Evidence for a below-mainstream curve: drive-away campaigns rolled over month to month since launch, 10% standing novated discount, young brand with no resale record

lowConfidence: jaecoo-j5-ev-summit.bootLitresSeatsDown: 1,180 L is to the roof (pairs with 480 L to roof); no belt-line figure published
jaecoo-j5-ev-summit.rangeKm: 399 km WLTP TEH from Jaecoo UK/EV Database vs AU sheet 402 km (TEL); choice of the TEH end is judged, 0.75% apart
jaecoo-j5-ev-summit.consumptionKwhPer100km: derived from battery/range, cross-check tautological; Jaecoo's claimed 14.3 not used
